_meta.purpose: The fifth Daily-5 post: useful, conversion-aware conversation prompts. Not memes, not lightweight fun-bank content. Each post should create a reason to save, comment, compare options, or take one clear action on Internwise.
rules: No recycled fun/meme formats from the old plan.
Each prompt must be useful even if nobody comments.
Every post carries a clear Internwise next step.

ideas.takeaway: Save one role that gives you enough confidence to act.
ideas.cta: Find one worth saving at internwise.co.uk
